opinions.text:
Julio M. Fuentes Circuit Judge
The petition for rehearing filed by appellees in the above-entitled case having been submitted to the judges who participated in the decision of this Court, it is hereby ORDERED that the petition for rehearing by the panel is granted. The opinion and judgment entered November 15, 2018 are hereby VACATED. A subsequent opinion and judgment will be issued.
As the merits panel has vacated the prior opinion and judgment, action is not required by the en banc court.
